about.label: // About
about.title: I build software with quality, impact, and long-term sustainability in mind
paragraphs: I have more than six years of experience building digital products for fintech, enterprise services, and AI-driven initiatives.
My approach combines technical vision and product thinking: I prioritize scalability, code maintainability, and a clear user experience.
I have worked with multicultural remote teams, leading technical decisions and supporting continuous improvement processes.

experience.label: // Experience
experience.title: Professional journey
experience.subtitle: Roles across fullstack development, architecture, and AI-enabled solutions.

bullets: Designed and implemented production-grade AI agents and intelligent workflows, ensuring top-tier reliability and traceability.
Built automated internal tools and dashboard engines that optimized team operational efficiency on critical daily operations.
Architected and integrated responsive web interfaces connected to low-latency backend microservices for mission-critical apps.
Collaborated on key architecture and infrastructure decisions to scale the technical stack while securing high availability.
Architected, scaled, and maintained high-throughput financial microservices supporting secure payment transactions.
Developed and optimized React Native modules for mobile payment SDKs, securing flawless cross-platform performance.
Optimized core payment processing engines and orchestrated integrations across complex REST and SOAP architectures.
Introduced automated code-quality pipelines and established collaborative peer code-review standards.
Leveraged Docker and containerized, reproducible environments to accelerate deployment cycles and minimize live incidents.
Developed enterprise software solutions for digital transformation initiatives.
Implemented modular software architectures to improve maintainability and scalability.
Supported technical planning and delivery tracking for key milestones.
Produced structured technical documentation for project continuity and support readiness.
